header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ قَتَادَةَ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: اِذَا دَخَلْتُمْ بَيْتًا فَسَلِّمُوْا عَلي اَهْلِهِ، وَاِذَا خَرَجْتُمْ فَاَوْدِعُوْا اَهْلَهُ السَّلَامَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Qatadah (RH) has narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said: “When you go to anyone's house, say “Salam” to the people of that house! And when you leave (the house), take leave of the people of that house by saying “Salam”.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: اذَا انْتَهَي اَحَدُكُمْ اِلي مَجْلِسٍ فَلْيُسَلِّمْ، فَاِنْ بَدَا لَهُ اَنْ يَجْلِسَ فَلْيَجْلِسْ، ثُمَّ اِذَا قَامَ فَلْيُسَلِّمْ، فَلَيْسَتِ اْلاُوْلي بِاَحَقَّ مِنَ اْلآخِرَةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن باب ماجاء في التسليم عند القيام ...رقم:٢٧٠٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “When one of you goes to any gathering, let him say Salam to those in the gathering. Then, if he wishes to sit, let him sit, and then when he gets up and leaves that gathering, let him say Salam again. For the first Salam is not superior to the last Salam” (just as saying Salam when meeting is Sunnah, so too saying Salam when taking leave is Sunnah).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: يُسَلِّمُ الصَّغِيْرُ عَلَي الْكَبِيْرِ، وَالْمَارُّ عَلَي الْقَاعِدِ، وَالْقَلِيْلُ عَلَي الْكَثِيْرِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب تسليم القليل علي الكثير رقم:٦٢٣١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Let the younger say Salam to the elder, let the one passing by say Salam to the one sitting, and let the smaller group say Salam to the larger number.”
